name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: A four-step progress path: each step is a small numbered circle above a bold title and a muted description, with Back and Next buttons underneath. Reaching a step fills the previous circle into a tick.
use: A short linear flow needs its position and finished steps visible at a glance.
avoid: Four titles with descriptions need width, so a narrow screen would crowd the row badly.
a11y: Each step is a real button with text and a focus ring, but the current step is shown by numbering and colour only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four evenly spaced steps across a black stage, each a small circle above a bold label and a dim line of text. Completed circles are white with a dark tick, the current one is white with its number, the rest stay grey; two small buttons sit centred beneath.
behaves: Clicking Next fills the current circle with a tick and lights the next step, Back reverses it, and clicking a circle jumps straight to that step. Both buttons dim when they reach either end.
customise: Compose items, triggers, indicators, titles, descriptions and separators; orientation, active value and per-step loading or disabled are props.
weight: light: Four small circles and labels with short scale transitions.
